record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Consider a Hamiltonian system with a center at the origin and Hamiltonian H(x,y) = H_{2n}(x,y) + H_m(x,y), where H_{2n} and H_m are homogeneous polynomials of degrees 2n and m with m > 2n. Determine whether the period annulus of the origin can have more than one critical period.

evidence.quote: Problem 12. Consider a Hamiltonian system with a center at the origin and Hamiltonian H(x,y ) =H2n(x,y ) +Hm(x,y ), m> 2n, whereH2n and Hm are homogeneous polynomials of degrees 2n and m, respectively. Has the period annulus of the origin at most 1 critical period?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H_{2n}(x,y)$ and $H_m(x,y)$ be real homogeneous polynomials of degrees $2n$ and $m$, respectively, with integers $m > 2n \ge 2$. Consider the planar Hamiltonian system
$$\dot{x} = \frac{\partial H}{\partial y}(x,y), \qquad \dot{y} = -\frac{\partial H}{\partial x}(x,y),$$
with Hamiltonian $H(x,y) = H_{2n}(x,y) + H_m(x,y)$, and assume that the origin is a center, so that it is surrounded by a period annulus $\mathcal{P}$ foliated by periodic orbits $\gamma_s$ parameterized (e.g. by energy or by amplitude) over an open interval $s \in (0, s^*)$. Let $T(s)$ denote the minimal period of $\gamma_s$. A value $s_0 \in (0, s^*)$ is called a critical period if $T'(s_0)=0$. 

Determine whether, for every choice of homogeneous polynomials $H_{2n}$ and $H_m$ as above giving rise to a center at the origin, the period function $T(s)$ has at most one critical period in $\mathcal{P}$.
artifact.category_tag: Critical periods of planar Hamiltonian centers
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on critical periods of sums of two quasi-homogeneous Hamiltonian vector fields (Zhuang–Liu, Qual. Theory Dyn. Syst., 2023) addresses this question and gives a positive answer in the range $m \ge 4n-2$, while the intermediate range $2n < m < 4n-2$ (the simplest open case being $H = H_4 + H_5$) appears to remain open. Thus the problem is only partially resolved.

status_evidence.title: Critical Periods of the Sum of Two Quasi-Homogeneous Hamiltonian Vector Fields
status_evidence.snippet: Critical periods of period annulus for Hamiltonian systems formed by the sum of two quasi-homogeneous polynomials; provides a (partial) positive answer to Gasull's Problem 12.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of having at most one critical period is positively answered for sums of two quasi-homogeneous Hamiltonians in suitable degree ranges.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems (Gasull)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 12 asks whether the period annulus of the origin of a Hamiltonian H = H_{2n}+H_m, m>2n, has at most one critical period.
status_evidence.claim: The question is stated as an open problem in Gasull's list.
